label: Bless India Posters
_comment: Experimental plugin: our whole-India poster attempts, generated live (no stored rasters). The attempts ship in the PUBLIC build for this plugin; the whole-country poster on Country Posters stays withheld. posterDesign registers each design in the Poster Design catalogue; names are ledgered and never renamed once shipped. mobileFriendly stays false until a design is proven to generate + print on a phone without crashing (the desktop-only rule shows meanwhile). More designs (four-sides 5x8, paired-rows 5.5x5.5) land with later attempts.
